knownGaps.observation: Single and bulk updates resolve omitted DueEndTime from the stored habit, then apply an explicit deadline change only when supplied.

Habit summaries render extended fields and checklist/reminder values. Update tools accept extended fields, direct MCP title is optional, and create_habit accepts is_general. Start dates, parent identities, tag ids and names, and linked habit ids and titles are checked in the per-field readback cells.

Checklist template updates, profile name updates and calendar selection writes are registered. Calendar overview returns effective IsSynced flags alongside persisted calendar ids and explicit or default selection mode.
HabitUpdateParams carries StartDate; the write schemas and rendered habit summaries are checked in the StartDate cells.
Filter-keyed bulk update/reschedule/delete/log/skip routes exist. MCP log reads include partial and returned counts. Inspect parameter paths to distinguish predicates from explicit IDs.
unlog_habit is registered on both surfaces and explicitly removes a completion; log_habit no longer toggles. HabitLog.delete records the dedicated undo route.
set_proactive_astra is registered on both surfaces; readback is checked separately in Profile.ProactiveAstraEnabled.
Emoji is accepted on MCP create/update and returned by get_habit/list_habits; inspect the Habit.Emoji cells and filter-keyed bulk cells.
